title: Studio engine: widen the sibilance search window to ~3-14 kHz?
body: F15 measures sibilance on fricative events correctly between ~4 and ~9 kHz, but the 15% edge guard on the 3-10 kHz window returns nothing above ~8.95 kHz, and bright fricatives read low (Tale research 8669 Hz vs engine 7737 Hz). Approve a small engine lane?
